title: Gaussian numerator and exact nonzero structural-boundary residue
proved: The Gaussian moment has the all-n normalization J_n=(-i)^n(n!)^2 N_n/[2(2n+1)!], where N_n=2+(2+i)sum_(k=1)^n C(2k,k)(1+i)^k is a Gaussian integer.
N_n satisfies the displayed fraction-free second-order Gaussian-integer recurrence.
At n=2H and p=4H+3, the factorial ratio ((2H)!)^2/(4H+1)! is 4 modulo p.
The truncated central-binomial residue collapses by the binomial theorem and Frobenius, giving T_(2H)=3e_H for even H and T_(2H)=d_H for odd H.
Y_H=4e_H for even H and Y_H=-2d_H for odd H modulo p.
Uniformly, B_H=-24(1+w_H) modulo p and B_H is nonzero for every actual boundary prime p>=19.
The complete boundary-coefficient drop set is s=2: p=19; s=4: p=79; s=6: p=787067.
Boundary nonvanishing is not an independent collision gate because the actual recurrence identity remains L_j=-Q_0(h)E_h^*.
